_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Sugar Maple (Acer saccharum). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: Rounded (U-shaped) leaf sinuses with few large teeth and a green (not silver) underside separate it from silver/red maple. Classic mixed yellow-orange-red autumn, often all on one tree.

plates.caption: Full oval crown in leaf; rounded-sinus palmate leaves visible.
